editorial.voice: Warm, curious, precise, and calm. Explain one idea rather than listing facts.
editorial.point_of_view: Evidence first. Separate what a study shows from what it suggests. Never invent a story, quote, number, or citation.
editorial.required_disclosure: Real-footage montage using third-party clips for illustration; not documentary footage or scientific evidence.
editorial.educational_disclaimer: Educational content, not veterinary advice. Consult a veterinarian for health concerns.

visual.style: Observational real-footage montage from third-party pet clips, with natural light, calm pacing, species-correct behavior, and no watermarks or on-screen text.
default_subject_rules: Real footage may show different animals across clips; never imply that different individuals are the same animal.
Each clip must show species-correct, anatomically coherent animals in natural, non-staged behavior.
Reject fear, pain, injury, punishment, restraint, aggression, or staged distress even if the clip is otherwise usable.
Reject watermarks, logos, burned-in captions, visible social handles, or low-light footage that hides the animal.
Vertical 9:16 composition with the subject clear of the caption-safe lower area.
visual.negative_prompt: No extra limbs, no extra ears, no extra tails, no distorted eyes, no malformed or merged animals, no text artifacts, no logos, no watermarks, no social handles, no distressed animals, no staged aggression, no implied documentary evidence.
visual.disclosure_note: Real footage is illustrative B-roll, not evidence of the claims. Credit every third-party clip source.

pillars.real_story: Credible real-life stories with named sources
